recipe.name: Phrynosoma — the horned crown / investment / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Limits inherited from this design; choose a sand recipe to replace them

manufacturing.bench_notes: Factory 016 Star, unmirrored, poured in lost wax. A horned lizard's head lies on the table, its snout toward one along-ring point and its crown of horns fanned over the points behind it. Feed from the palm; invest horn tips up. At the bench: tack and file any short-filled horn tip; polish the horns and the skull's plates, leave the hollows satin.
